pro_tips: Standardize naming conventions for audio line items so reporting remains consistent across flights.
For podcasts travel campaigns, align KPIs to the funnel stage (awareness vs consideration vs conversion) before buying inventory.
Lock measurement tags and pixels before trafficking to avoid gaps in attribution.
Create a mid-flight optimization cadence (daily/weekly) with decision thresholds.
Document learnings in a reusable playbook so each new podcasts travel flight improves performance.
